meta.title: DSH Memories
meta.description: Personal memory for DSH: every new session starts with a how-to-use-your-memories guide plus a global long-term index, a global short-term note, and a workspace memory index, each injected whole; memory files carry a one-line Description feeding the index, and INDEX.md is regenerated by a repo script — the plugin never writes it; the /memory command and the agent memory tool write and preview memories; the Memories right-sidebar tab lists all memories and shows each one's full content on a detail page, scoped to the current session's workspace.
